note.question: What determines the maintenance of a machine that deteriorates according to a Markov process until it fails?
note.overview: This paper studies the maintenance of a machine that deteriorates according to a Markov process until it fails. When failure occurs (which is observable), corrective replacement is made. Otherwise, the machine can be in one of two unobservable working states, and the decision maker can choose production, inspection, or preventive replacement.
